scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: 'sbp' appears in the provided trial_measured_features list, so the feature is observed in the dataset. G2: The hypothesis only states that baseline SBP changes baseline cardiovascular risk or disease burden without naming any concrete biological steps (receptor, enzyme, PK/PD) that would cause differential drug action, so G2 FALSE — cascade: G3..G5 also FALSE. G3: Because G2 failed (no mechanistic pathway), the claim reduces to an absolute-risk/prognostic argument rather than a specific PD/PK or pathophysiological modifier, so G3 FALSE — cascade: G4..G5 also FALSE. G4: Given G2 and G3 are false there is no specified mechanistic interaction to check against the literature, so G4 FALSE. G5: Without a biologically coherent, causal interaction and supportive literature, no clear actionable SBP-defined treatment subgroup is proposed, so G5 FALSE.
scored_features.justification: Decisive gate: G2 FALSE — the hypothesis gives only an epidemiologic/absolute-risk argument (SBP → baseline risk) and does not specify a biological PK/PD pathway by which SBP would alter the effect of intensive BP lowering.
